expectations.text: MD034 is correctly described as flagging bare URLs (URLs NOT wrapped in angle brackets)
expectations.evidence: Section 'MD034 — Bare URL Used' (lines 13-17) correctly describes: 'MD034 flags any bare URL in markdown — a URL that appears as plain text without being wrapped in angle brackets or formatted as a proper markdown link'

expectations.text: The fix described is to wrap URLs in angle brackets <> or use [text](url) format
expectations.evidence: Section 'How to Fix' (lines 30-48) describes both options: 'Option A — Wrap in angle brackets' and 'Option B — Use a proper markdown link with descriptive text', with code examples provided for each

expectations.text: Both URLs in the content are identified as violating MD034
expectations.evidence: Section 'Issues Found in the Content' (lines 21-26) explicitly identifies both URLs: 'Line 1: `https://github.com/example/repo` — bare URL' and 'Line 3: `https://docs.example.com/guide` — bare URL'
